activities.activity_description: Configure Spring Security to enable SSL/HTTPS and Basic authentication for administration endpoints.
Implement a Python processor using stdin/stdout for data computation and statistical analysis.
Integrate an R processor using rJava for streaming pipeline data computations.
Develop a Hive sink to write data into distributed storage for querying and management.
Upgrade Spring Core to version 4.1.1 milestone, including dependency updates and compatibility testing.
Define security policies for REST API entities with group/role-based access control.
Implement ACLs to restrict resource access (e.g., stream creation/destruction/viewing) via the DSL Shell.
Implement ACLs to restrict resource access via the Admin UI, including stream management actions.
Perform integration testing across all implemented features to ensure compatibility and security.
